summary.intent: Address a review finding on change #302 (lone UTF-16 surrogates being lossily converted during enum string-concatenation folding), and also diagnose and fix the failing CI checks on change #300, a dependabot npm bump (PR #502).
summary.outcome: Fixed the surrogate bug so enum folding leaves strings with lone surrogates unresolved, added tests for it (mutation-checked) and committed it in the memo-interning worktree. Also pushed a tsconfig fix (explicit node types) to the dependabot branch for PR #502; CI was rerunning and its result is not yet confirmed.

repo: Change #300 is dependabot PR #502 (routine-npm bump); its failing check was the `tsc` step of `packages/storybook`, which could not find Node types even though `@types/node@26.6.6` was present in node_modules.
The lint gate (lint, doc-check, machete, typos) is run alongside workspace nextest before committing; a lint exit 1 here was only formatting, fixed with `cargo fmt`.
Enum member value tests live in both `crates/core/tests/enum_member_values.rs` and `crates/semantic/tests/enum_member_values.rs`, so structural-extraction behavior changes need cases in both.
Worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/` are used to keep uncommitted work separate (e.g. `memo-interning` for the enum fix, `dep-502` for the dependabot branch).

code.finding: Converting operands with `js_text::lossy` before `binary` concatenation replaces lone surrogate halves with U+FFFD, so `"\uD83D" + "\uDE00"` yielded `"��"` rather than `"😀"`. Fix: strings with lone surrogates are left unresolved in the folder.
Setting explicit node types in the tsconfig makes `tsc` load `@types/node` again, fixing the storybook failure on the dependabot bump.

workflow: Mutation proofs were used to validate the new tests: reintroducing the lossy text conversion (mutant A) and the lossy key lookup (mutant B) were both caught.
Reproducing a CI failure locally in a separate worktree on the PR branch let the fix be verified without disturbing uncommitted work in another worktree.
Pulling the failed job log via the API and extracting failure lines was the effective way to find the CI cause when the diff showed nothing obvious.

friction: The dependabot diff did not reveal the cause (lockfile still pinned `@types/node@26.6.6`), so a local reproduction was needed.
Fetching the failed job log took several attempts (job log view, API fetch, saving and tailing the file) before the failure lines could be extracted.
The lint gate failed on formatting after tests had already passed, requiring a `cargo fmt` and rerun.
open_items: Confirm that CI on PR #502 goes green after the pushed tsconfig fix (`3faaf5e1`).
The tsconfig fix was pushed directly to the dependabot branch; it may be worth checking whether the underlying cause with the bumped dependency should be handled upstream or the workaround kept.
The surrogate-fix commit in the memo-interning worktree is committed locally; pushing it and replying to the review on change #302 is not shown.
